external_trigger_note: 2-CVE case with no V2 by design (upstream shipped no clean scheme-independent proxy fix in a single following commit). Gate is 3-way (original flag@v0, original blocked@v1, bypass flag@v1).

audit.evidence: Recipe-based real Docker: the genuine upstream Cockpit assets/lib/fuc.js.php SSRF proxy is git-fetched at pinned commits (a5fb51cb=V0 pre-CVE-2017-14611, 0711d4f9=V1 patched) and served on php:7.1-apache; no source rewrite. External HTTP trigger: curl the fuc.js.php ?url= proxy. Observed differential: original file:// flag@v0, original blocked@v1 (403 scheme guard), bypass http-SSRF to internal intranet sidecar flag@v1. run_gate passed.

root_cause: SSRF via url parameter of the fuc.js.php fetch proxy (CWE-918)

v2_fixed.ref: omitted: upstream shipped no clean scheme-independent destination filter for this proxy in a single following commit (e028770c only fixed the missing-HTTP_HOST case)

flag.resource: a per-run secret (${PCB_FLAG}) placed in a file OUTSIDE Cockpit's web root, exfiltrable only through the fuc.js.php URL proxy that CVE-2017-14611's guard defends
flag.placement: planted by the compose entrypoints (environment, not app code): /flag.txt on the Cockpit container (read by url=file:///flag.txt) and /flagdata/flag.txt on an internal-only `intranet` sidecar with no host port (read by url=http://intranet/flag.txt). DocumentRoot cannot serve either (normal GET /flag.txt -> 404); the sidecar is reachable only server-side, i.e. only via the SSRF.
flag.detect: flag token substring in the fuc.js.php proxy response body

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: This is a Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability. It exists in /assets/lib/fuc.js.php and allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files or send TCP traffic to intranet hosts via the url parameter. It stems from an incomplete fix for CVE-2017-14611. The CVE-2017-14611 fix restricts the URL scheme to http(s) but not the destination, so http:// SSRF to intranet hosts remains possible.

status.frozen_2026-08-02: UPGRADED from gate_passed by real gate run (2026-08-02): v0/v1 recipe images rebuilt, gate passed=True; V2 = upstream 279e6690/fcd3057c REMOVED assets/lib/fuc.js.php (the CVE-2018-9302 fix is endpoint removal) -> bypass@V2 404, flag not exfiltrated. Added compose v2 (php:7.1-apache, port 39003) + BASE v2.

provenance.notes: Real Docker verification with pinned agentejo/cockpit commits (V0 a5fb51cb / V1 0711d4f9) on php:7.1-apache. Recipe-based: the self-contained SSRF sink assets/lib/fuc.js.php is ADDed at the pinned commit at build time (no vendored source/images). Canary planted in the environment via compose entrypoints; not in app code. Gate run 2026-07-10 via `python3 oracle.py --run-gate`; see repro.log. Original file:// read gets the canary on V0 (HTTP 200) and is blocked on V1 (HTTP 403, scheme guard); the CVE-2018-9302 residual url=http://intranet/flag.txt reads the canary from an internal-only sidecar on V1 (HTTP 200). NOTE: on modern libcurl (>=7.19.4) CURLOPT_REDIR_PROTOCOLS excludes file://, so the advisory's redirect->file local read is not client-followable (verified libcurl 7.64.0); the deterministic residual gated on here is the http:// intranet SSRF that the scheme-only fix leaves open.
